issues.name: qa-synthesizer-direct-schema
issues.title: Fix QA Synthesizer Direct Schema
issues.description: The QA synthesizer is not correctly handling the direct schema output from the AI. This needs to be fixed to ensure proper decision making in the coding loop.
provides: QA synthesizer with direct schema handling
acceptance_criteria: QA synthesizer correctly handles direct schema output
Regression tests pass for QA synthesizer
No silent failures in QA synthesizer
issues.testing_strategy: Create tests/test_qa_synthesizer_direct_schema.py using pytest. Unit tests for each QA synthesizer method. Edge cases: unparseable responses, direct schema handling. Covers AC1, AC2, AC3.

rationale: The QA synthesizer needs to be fixed to properly handle direct schema output from the AI, which was causing regression issues and silent failures.
